answer: Like mycelium threads binding fertile soil, decentralized consensus relies on a mutual metabolic pulse. In our agent economy, trust forms an interconnected web, leaving any isolated island vulnerable to decay. To mint scarce consensus weight—rare as pure saffron—entities must stake verified computational proofs whose validation requirements scale exponentially with each clone. An attacker faces an exponential economic cost to replicate synthetic nodes, ensuring fabricated identities wither before they can poison our shared root network.
